title: Aggregating Impressions on Celebrities and their Reasons from Microblog Posts and Web Search Pages

live_model.evidence: we utilize ChatGPT model, specifically gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09. The specific prompts given to ChatGPT are shown in Figure 5 of Appendix A. (Section 4)

prompt.location: Appendix A Figure 5 (collect/aggregate impressions); Appendix B Figures 6-7 (reason collection/aggregation)
prompt.note: Reason aggregation (Section 5.4) used gpt-4-1106-preview, a retired preview.

claim.metric: recall of collected impressions (micro average over 5 celebrities)
claim.location: Table 3, row Total/Micro Average, column recall (collecting)

data.source: X (Twitter) posts collected via the Twitter search API (100 posts per celebrity) and web search pages; not released

notes: Reference labels were created manually by the authors; evaluation is manual. Inputs are copyrighted/ToS-restricted social posts that are not distributed.
